business_type: mature compounder (regulated-adjacent nuclear generation with AI-demand optionality)
moat_source: the largest US nuclear fleet - unreplicable carbon-free baseload in a power-short grid; evidence: hyperscalers (Microsoft) signing decade-scale PPAs and a 20% growth target no other utility can credibly claim

returns.assumption_note: Convergence to scenario IV by year 5, ~60% closed by year 3. Adjusted operating earnings used as cash-flow proxy (utility convention; true FCF runs below EPS on nuclear capex) - documented deviation. Small dividend (~0.6%) excluded.

sensitivity_key_driver: hyperscaler PPA volume signed after PJM rules land (late 2026)
primary_model_risk: Regulatory timing: the bull case is not operational - it is a queue. PJM interconnection rules (late 2026), Crane's possible slip to 2031, and DOJ divestitures all sit outside management control. The base case assumes moderate PPA flow from 2027; if the queue stalls, CEG is a well-run 21x utility with 4% growth - the bear case.
expectations_gap_key_variable: PPA timing: after a 41% derating the price (-2.4% vs our expected IV) now fairly discounts the delay; this is the closest-to-fair-value name of the 27 analyzed - the AI premium is out, the option is nearly free
top_5_bull_arguments: The 41% drawdown removed the AI premium while the AI power-demand thesis remains intact - the option is now nearly free
Q1 beat with revenue doubling on Calpine; FY26 guidance affirmed - operations are not the problem
Largest US nuclear fleet = the scarcest asset in the power-hungry AI build-out; Microsoft already signed
PJM clarity in late 2026 is a dated, identifiable catalyst - rare in this market
20% management growth target; even half-delivery re-rates the stock toward the bull case ($359)
top_5_bear_arguments: Every catalyst is regulatory and none arrives before late 2026 - dead money at best until then
Crane slipping to 2031 would impair $1.6B and the flagship Microsoft PPA narrative
DOJ divestitures already removed high-earning assets from the 2026-27 model
Nuclear capex means true FCF runs well below the EPS the multiple is quoted on
If AI datacenter demand forecasts deflate, nuclear scarcity pricing deflates with them
thesis_breakers: Crane restart officially delayed beyond 2029 or Microsoft PPA renegotiated
PJM rules landing adverse to co-located data-center deals
No new hyperscaler PPA signed within 12 months of PJM clarity
position_size_recommendation: 1-2%; fair price for a wide-moat asset with a dated catalyst - the most defensible new-money entry among the non-software names analyzed
notes_on_nulls: ROIC/ROE/ROA null: not captured as sourced ratios. EPS/guidance/revenue reported; earnings used as cash-flow proxy (utility convention, documented); PPA-driven growth path is constructed - confidence_level medium.
historical_context: Directional context only - low confidence.
